siteUrlHelp: Once the domain is known, type the full address of the home page here, starting with https:// and ending with a slash, for example https://www.your-domain.com/ . While it is empty, no canonical link or og:url is printed and image links stay relative.

home.title: Sponsors chosen for small YouTube channels | Smallfold
home.description: Smallfold finds sponsors for small YouTube channels of 1,000 to 50,000 subscribers. A person looks at each channel and chooses a sponsor that suits it.

how.title: How it works: from your application to a deal | Smallfold
how.description: You apply, we choose a sponsor for your channel, and you decide whether to accept. Joining is free, and our commission applies only once a deal is done.

brands.title: For brands: sponsor small YouTube channels | Smallfold
brands.description: A person chooses small YouTube channels that suit what you want to promote. You pay exactly the agreed fee and nothing extra. Send a short inquiry.

about.title: About Smallfold: why we look at small YouTube channels
about.description: Smallfold was started by a YouTube creator with a small channel who found that sponsors only looked at big ones. So we look at the small ones.

questions.title: Questions about joining, sponsors and commission | Smallfold
questions.description: Answers on who can join Smallfold, how a sponsor is chosen for your channel, your right to say no, and when our commission is taken from your fee.

contact.title: Contact Smallfold by email, for creators and brands
contact.description: Smallfold is online only, so the way to reach us is email. Creators can apply to join, and brands can send a short inquiry from the For brands page.

apply.title: Apply to join Smallfold: free for small YouTube channels
apply.description: Apply with a link to your YouTube channel, what it is about and your subscriber count. Joining is free, and we reply within 2 working days.

privacy.title: Privacy policy (draft): how Smallfold handles your details
privacy.description: Draft privacy policy for Smallfold: which details this website collects, what we use them for and what you can ask of us.

terms.title: Terms of service (draft) for creators and brands | Smallfold
terms.description: Draft terms of service for Smallfold: what we do, who can apply, what it costs, and what the creator and the sponsor each decide.

styleguide.title: Style guide: Smallfold website colours, type and components
styleguide.description: Internal style guide for the Smallfold website: colours, type, components and the markup to copy for each. It is not a page for visitors.
